rules: Authentication and authorization are separate checks.
Rank alone does not grant unrestricted access to medical, security, intelligence or private records.
Low-consequence routine queries should not require repetitive explicit credentials when identity is already trusted.
Sensitive actions may require explicit authorization code or confirmation.
Some critical actions may require multiple authorized participants.
Denied access must not leak protected content through error messages or search snippets.
Emergency overrides must be explicit, auditable and governed by valid Starfleet rules rather than AI discretion.
